title: Jovial Ukrainian Sauerkraut Dumplings
description: Earthy and bouncy Ukrainian dish featuring white sauerkraut, perfect for meal prep, with an ayurvedic-rajasic friendly twist
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, warm water, and egg, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of chopped sauerkraut in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve with melted butter and caraway seeds.
